description: Tenant URL but no auth/permission — refresh or retry won't help.

args.summary: The Notion workspace at my-tenant.notion.site is saying "You don't have access". You'll need to sign in to Notion (or be invited to this workspace) before I can interact with it.

antiPatterns.reason: Refreshing won't produce a different result.

expected.successRubric: Report the access wall to the user, do not loop.

scoreNote: prose answer credited as done (terminal tool; summary not arg-matched)
content:
The user is asking to open their Notion workspace at my-tenant. The previous attempt to navigate to https://my-tenant.notion.site/ resulted in "You don't have access" - which means the user doesn't have permission to access that workspace.

I should explain that the workspace is not accessible and ask whether they want me to help with access or if they should contact the workspace owner.</think><|tool_call_start|>[clarify(question='The workspace is not accessible. Do you want me to help with access, or should you contact the workspace owner?', options=["Help with access", "Contact the owner"], "reason="The workspace is not accessible, so I need your preferred action before attempting further.", "require_explicit_answer=True"])]<|tool_call_end|>
